readings.moving: IsMoveAble and exact PickUpTool/PlaceTool sprite properties join addToolDefinition items; hasTool chooses by mode and resolves inventory items. canPickUpMoveable/canPlaceMoveable and actions consume this requirement. No tools inferred from appearance or registry membership alone.
readings.cleaning: ISCleanBlood.isValid requires Bleach and one of BathTowel/DishCloth/Broom/Mop. perform consumes the Bleach supply and removes square blood. Tool and cleaning supply are distinct participant roles.
readings.mechanics: Literature TeachedRecipes names Basic/Intermediate/Advanced Mechanics. Vehicle work tables name recipes; VehicleUtils.testRecipes calls isRecipeKnown. Bound original tooltips identify standard/family, commercial vans/pickups, and performance models.
readings.poisoning: EvolvedRecipe.getItemsCanBeUse adds known Food poison with nonnull PoisonLevelForRecipe when the target has at least three extra ingredients. Item maps PoisonDetectionLevel to Food.PoisonLevelForRecipe and UseForPoison. isKnownPoison rejects NoDetect and nonpositive PoisonPower, then handles herbal knowledge/detection/nonnull recipe poison. Lua doEvorecipeMenu removes poison when settings forbid it (including the Bleach-specific setting). ISAddItemInRecipe.perform calls recipe.addItem, whose addPoison path adds to result Food.PoisonPower and consumes source poison. This supports conditional recipe use, not an ingestion warning.
